title: Eventual vanishing of canonical constant-module pushforward germs
statement: Fix a universe u, a commutative ring Lambda in Type (u+1), a Lambda-module M, and schemes X and Y in universe u [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let I be a small cofiltered category and D:I -> Scheme a diagram with affine transitions. Let p_i:D_i -> X be qcqs structure maps with equations hp_g:D(g) followed by p_i = p_j for every g:j -> i. Let nu:Y -> X be qcqs and pi:const(Y) -> D a limiting cone, with pi_i followed by p_i = nu. Constant module sheaves, their direct images, and canonical maps are those of [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and [lem-weil-pbc-constant-module-pushforward-functoriality]. For every point s of X, stage i, and element x of the geometric stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] at the universe-lifted algebraic-closure point above s of p_i,* M_Di, suppose that the canonical map induced by pi_i sends x to zero in the stalk of nu_* M_Y. Then there exist a stage j and an arrow g:j -> i such that the canonical map induced by D(g) sends x to zero in the stalk of p_j,* M_Dj.

source.place: Tag 09Z1, proof at degree zero on affine etale neighborhoods; Tag 09YQ, degree-zero continuity; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09Z1 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YQ on 2026-10-12

proof.text: Represent x by a section a of the constant module sheaf over U times_X D_i, with U an affine etale neighborhood of the chosen geometric point of X. Because its image germ is zero, refine U to an affine etale neighborhood where the restricted section on U times_X Y is actually zero. This is the defining eventual-equality description of the geometric stalk.

Put E_j=U times_X D_j and E_limit=U times_X Y. Pullback preserves the limit cone (cofiltered categories are connected), affine transitions, and qcqs morphisms. Since U is affine, all E_j are qcqs. Regard the system as lying over U; this base is quasi-separated, even though X need not be. If a directed index is required, apply final directed reindexing to I opposite. Finality supplies a common refinement and an arrow to the original stage.

Forget coefficients in the section equality to abelian groups. A constant module sheaf has the constant underlying abelian sheaf: the coefficient forgetful functor preserves colimits and finite limits, hence commutes with the plus sheafification construction. Pullback identifies each constant sheaf with the inverse image of the constant sheaf G on U. By naturality of this identification with the adjunction unit, the constantModulePushforwardMap section maps are the unitComparison section maps after these identifications; equivalently both send constant generators to the same constant generators. Direct-image composition is the usual fiber-product pasting identification.

Apply the injectivity half of continuity of sections at an inverse limit to the scheme system E over the quasi-separated base U, constant abelian G on U, and the identity etale object of U. The stage section a has zero restriction to E_limit, so the theorem gives a later stage E_j and an arrow g:j -> i on which its restriction is zero. In the directed reindexing variant, compare representatives in the final colimit and take a common refinement to obtain such an arrow in I.

The forgetful functor reflects equality of section elements, so the same restriction vanishes as a module section. Passing to its germ and using the canonical-map identification of step 3 gives the displayed vanishing under constantModulePushforwardMap. No colimit of direct images, arbitrary diagram presentation K, or arbitrary cocone c occurs in this statement. The zero module, empty limit, and singleton index all satisfy the same argument.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_constantModulePushforward_germ_eq_zero
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (p : ∀ i, D.obj i ⟶ X)
    (hp : ∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), D.map g ≫ p j = p i)
    [∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g)]
    [∀ i : I, QuasiCompact (p i)] [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparated (p i)]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (ν : Y ⟶ X)
    (π : (Functor.const I).obj Y ⟶ D) (hπ : ∀ i, π.app i ≫ p i = ν)
    [QuasiCompact ν] [QuasiSeparated ν]
    (hc : IsLimit (Cone.mk Y π))
    (s : X) (i : I)
    (x : ((X.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber
      (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (p i)).obj
          ((constantSheaf (D.obj i).smallEtaleTopology
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)))
    (hx : ((X.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber
      (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map
        (constantModulePushforwardMap Λ M (p i) ν (π.app i) (hπ i)) x = 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (g : j ⟶ i),
      ((X.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber
        (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map
          (constantModulePushforwardMap Λ M (p i) (p j) (D.map g) (hp g)) x = 0
